research_interests.title: Research Interests
research_interests.description: Seeking a research-oriented Master's degree as preparation for a future Ph.D. My interests lie at the intersection of Mathematical Optimization, Operations Research, Machine Learning, and Autonomous Systems, with the goal of developing intelligent agents capable of robust decision-making under uncertainty.

bullet_points.description: Research at the intersection of mathematical optimization and machine learning, at the SLSCM Lab, National Economics University.
Developed optimization-based learning models and formulated mathematical constraints using Gurobi, CPLEX, and DOcplex.
Selected for Techcombank's highly competitive Management Associate Program.
Contributed to enterprise AI infrastructure, including knowledge graphs, vector search systems, and semantic retrieval platforms.
Supported the development of AI foundation services for scalable internal intelligent applications.
Designed and deployed enterprise AI applications based on LLMs, RAG systems, and MLOps workflows.
Developed intelligent assistants, automated document-understanding systems, and productivity tools for business use.
Worked across the full lifecycle from problem formulation to implementation and deployment.

topics.topic_name: Enterprise Knowledge Graph & Vector Search Platform

bullet_points.description: Designed enterprise knowledge graph structures for large-scale retrieval and reasoning systems.
Built automated ETL and vector indexing pipelines using Databricks and CI/CD workflows.
Developed an LLM-powered credit appraisal assistant to support analysts in evaluating customer profiles, financial documents, and credit-related information.
Integrated retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, and enterprise knowledge sources to automate information retrieval and accelerate credit assessment workflows.
Developed a two-stage video copy detection framework using CLIP, RoBERTa, SwinV2, and Vision Transformers.
Applied contrastive learning to identify copied content and localize copied video segments.
Built an end-to-end MLOps pipeline for sentiment analysis of political social media data.
Integrated Apache Airflow, MLflow, PostgreSQL, Docker, and Grafana for orchestration and monitoring.
